app.already_running.message.source: Another KiwiDesk instance is already managing your windows, so this one will quit.
app.already_running.message.translation: Outra instância do KiwiDesk já está gerenciando suas janelas, portanto esta será encerrada.

app.already_running.title.translation: O KiwiDesk já está em execução

app_bar.alignment.label.help.source: Where the item group sits along the bar while it fits. Start and End follow the edge (a left bar's Start is its top); once items overflow and scroll, all three behave the same.
app_bar.alignment.label.help.translation: Onde o grupo de itens fica ao longo da barra enquanto houver espaço. Início e Fim seguem a borda (em uma barra à esquerda, Início é o topo); quando os itens transbordam e rolam, os três se comportam da mesma forma.

app_bar.background_fit.boxed_only.source: Boxed draws a box per item, not a shared plate, so there is nothing to size.
app_bar.background_fit.boxed_only.translation: Em caixas desenha uma caixa por item em vez de uma placa compartilhada, portanto não há o que redimensionar.

app_bar.color.gap_only.source: The Gap indicator hides the active item instead of marking it, so these colors aren't drawn.

app_bar.content.vertical_only.source: Left and right bars always show icons only.
app_bar.content.vertical_only.translation: Texto Left and right bars always show icons only. (PT)

app_bar.edge.label.help.source: Which screen edge the bar occupies. The bar reserves this edge in every layout that shows it.
app_bar.edge.label.help.translation: A borda da tela na qual a App Bar fica posicionada.

app_bar.global_style.caption.source: The App Bar appears in the layouts that show one — Monocle and Scrolling. These settings are shared; a layout can override any of them below.
app_bar.global_style.caption.translation: Uma barra por tela para todos os layouts. Todas as configurações são globais.

app_bar.group_adjacent.help.source: Merges neighbouring windows of the same app into a single item, marked with a count badge, instead of showing one item each.
app_bar.group_adjacent.help.translation: Texto Merges neighbouring windows of the same app into a single item, marked with a count badge, instead of showing one item each. (PT)

app_bar.icon_source.help.source: How app icons are drawn. Glyphs shows a monochrome symbol from KiwiDesk's built-in icon set, colored by the bar's item colors — Item, Active item, and Hover item below — so those colors also decide how the glyphs look. Apps without a symbol keep their app icon.
app_bar.icon_source.help.translation: Texto How app icons are drawn. Glyphs shows a monochrome symbol from KiwiDesk's built-in icon set, colored by the bar's item colors — Item, Active item, and Hover item below — so those colors also decide how the glyphs look. Apps without a symbol keep their app icon. (PT)

app_bar.icon_source.name_only.source: Icons are hidden while Content is Name.
app_bar.icon_source.name_only.translation: Texto Icons are hidden while Content is Name. (PT)

app_bar.layout.overrides.caption.source: Dimmed rows inherit the global value — tick a box to override just that field for this layout.
app_bar.layout.overrides.caption.translation: Texto Dimmed rows inherit the global value — tick a box to override just that field for this layout. (PT)

app_bar.layout.overrides.disabled.source: Turn on Show app bar to edit this layout's overrides. They are kept either way.
app_bar.layout.overrides.disabled.translation: Texto Turn on Show app bar to edit this layout's overrides. They are kept either way. (PT)

app_bar.liquid_glass.help.source: Lays a translucent glass material over the boxes or the plate. The Fill color tints it, though the tint reads subtle on current macOS.
app_bar.liquid_glass.help.translation: Texto Lays a translucent glass material over the boxes or the plate. The Fill color tints it, though the tint reads subtle on current macOS. (PT)

app_bar.no_layout.help.source: No layout shows an App Bar — turn one on below.
app_bar.no_layout.help.translation: Texto No layout shows an App Bar — turn one on below. (PT)

app_bar.preview.ax.translation: Pré-visualização da App Bar: posição %1$@, estilo %2$@.

app_rules.float.help.source:
Floating takes this app's matching windows out of tiling: each keeps its last position and size and appears on every space, instead of living in one space's grid.

This is per-app floating — not the **Floating** layout mode, which floats every window in a space.
app_rules.float.help.translation:
O modo floating remove as janelas correspondentes deste aplicativo do lado a lado: cada uma mantém sua última posição e tamanho e aparece em todos os espaços.

Isso é um floating por aplicativo — não o modo de layout Floating, que faz flutuar todas as janelas de um espaço.

app_rules.override.caption.source: Space and float rules made here apply to this profile only. Dimmed facets are inherited from the app-wide base rules and stay in sync with them; changing a facet overrides it for this profile, and deleting a row removes inherited rules here. To edit the base rules themselves, switch back to the currently loaded profile in the header's picker.
app_rules.override.caption.translation: Texto Space and float rules made here apply to this profile only. Dimmed facets are inherited from the app-wide base rules and stay in sync with them; changing a facet overrides it for this profile, and deleting a row removes inherited rules here. To edit the base rules themselves, switch back to the currently loaded profile in the header's picker. (PT)

app_rules.override.overrides.source: This profile overrides base app rules.
app_rules.override.overrides.translation: Texto This profile overrides base app rules. (PT)

app_rules.remove_all.help.source: Remove all rules for this app
app_rules.remove_all.help.translation: Texto Remove all rules for this app (PT)

app_rules.remove_override.help.source: Remove this profile's effective space and float rules for this app
app_rules.remove_override.help.translation: Texto Remove this profile's effective space and float rules for this app (PT)

app_rules.section.caption.source: Pin an app's windows to a space, keep them floating, or both. Deleting a row removes all of the app's rules.
app_rules.section.caption.translation: Texto Pin an app's windows to a space, keep them floating, or both. Deleting a row removes all of the app's rules. (PT)

app_rules.titled.caption.source: Windows whose title contains a pattern stay floating.
app_rules.titled.caption.translation: Texto Windows whose title contains a pattern stay floating. (PT)

bars.same_edge.source: Both bars share the %1$@ edge — Space Bar sits at the screen edge, App Bar sits next to the windows.

bars.switch.caption.source: KiwiDesk draws two bars — choose which one to configure.
bars.switch.caption.translation: Texto KiwiDesk draws two bars — choose which one to configure. (PT)

behavior.animations.scrolling_xref.source: Scrolling-layout focus shifts have their own toggle and speed in
behavior.animations.scrolling_xref.translation: Texto Scrolling-layout focus shifts have their own toggle and speed in (PT)

behavior.animations.space_change.caption.source: Windows slide out of the space you're leaving and into the one you're switching to.
behavior.animations.space_change.caption.translation: Texto Windows slide out of the space you're leaving and into the one you're switching to. (PT)

behavior.mouse.follows_focus.translation: Texto Move mouse to focused window (PT)

behavior.mouse.resize_action.help.source:
**Resize adjacent windows** — Dragging a window's edge resizes it and reflows its neighbours in the layout.
**Snap back to slot** — The window resizes freely while you drag, then snaps back to its tiled size when you release.
behavior.mouse.resize_action.help.translation:
Texto **Resize adjacent windows** — Dragging a window's edge resizes it and reflows its neighbours in the layout.
**Snap back to slot** — The window resizes freely while you drag, then snaps back to its tiled size when you release. (PT)

behavior.quit.caption.source: Before KiwiDesk stops, it arranges managed windows on each display so their title bars remain reachable.
behavior.quit.caption.translation: Texto Before KiwiDesk stops, it arranges managed windows on each display so their title bars remain reachable. (PT)

behavior.quit.summary.source: 2×2 up to %1$d windows · 3×3 up to %2$d · 4×4 above %2$d
behavior.quit.summary.translation: Texto 2×2 up to %1$d windows · 3×3 up to %2$d · 4×4 above %2$d (PT)

behavior.quit.target_depth.help.source: The grid adds a row and column when cells would exceed this target. It stays between 2×2 and 4×4; after 4×4, additional windows keep cascading in its cells.
behavior.quit.target_depth.help.translation: Texto The grid adds a row and column when cells would exceed this target. It stays between 2×2 and 4×4; after 4×4, additional windows keep cascading in its cells. (PT)

border.caption.source: Outlines the focused window so it stands out in a gapped layout.
border.caption.translation: Personalize a borda que envolve a janela com foco ou selecionada.

border.controls.disabled.source: Turn on Show focus border to edit these settings.
border.controls.disabled.translation: Texto Turn on Show focus border to edit these settings. (PT)

border.fit_gaps.action_hint.source: Updates the draft gap values. Save is still required.
border.fit_gaps.action_hint.translation: Texto Updates the draft gap values. Save is still required. (PT)

border.fit_gaps.help.source: Calculates global outer and inner gaps from the border width. Inner gaps allow for both borders when borders on unfocused windows are shown.
border.fit_gaps.help.translation: Texto Calculates global outer and inner gaps from the border width. Inner gaps allow for both borders when borders on unfocused windows are shown. (PT)

border.fit_gaps.preview.source: Will set Outer to %1$d pt and Inner to %2$d pt.

border.fit_gaps.updated.source: Draft updated — Save (⌘S) to apply and persist.
border.fit_gaps.updated.translation: Texto Draft updated — Save (⌘S) to apply and persist. (PT)

border.fit_gaps.updated_inactive.source: Draft updated — Save (⌘S) to persist; it applies when this profile is loaded.
border.fit_gaps.updated_inactive.translation: Texto Draft updated — Save (⌘S) to persist; it applies when this profile is loaded. (PT)

border.fit_gaps.updated_new.source: Draft updated — Save as New Profile… to apply and persist.
border.fit_gaps.updated_new.translation: Texto Draft updated — Save as New Profile… to apply and persist. (PT)

border.fit_gaps.updated_paused.source: Draft updated — gaps persist once Accessibility is on and you save the profile.
border.fit_gaps.updated_paused.translation: Texto Draft updated — gaps persist once Accessibility is on and you save the profile. (PT)

border.glow.a11y.source: Soft glow around the focus border
border.glow.a11y.translation: Texto Soft glow around the focus border (PT)

border.unfocused_enabled.translation: Texto Show border on unfocused windows (PT)

color_field.swatch.help_auto.translation: Texto Automatic — follows light and dark (PT)

config_issues.delete_confirm.body.source: This removes the profile file. It can't be undone.
config_issues.delete_confirm.body.translation: Texto This removes the profile file. It can't be undone. (PT)

config_issues.empty.body.source: The last configuration load completed cleanly.
config_issues.empty.body.translation: Texto The last configuration load completed cleanly. (PT)

config_issues.header.source: Parts of the configuration could not be loaded.
config_issues.header.translation: Texto Parts of the configuration could not be loaded. (PT)

config_issues.profile_unreadable.source: Couldn't be loaded — it was saved by a different version or edited by hand.
config_issues.profile_unreadable.translation: Texto Couldn't be loaded — it was saved by a different version or edited by hand. (PT)

config_issues.reload.help.source: Re-runs the config load; fixed files clear their issues.
config_issues.reload.help.translation: Texto Re-runs the config load; fixed files clear their issues. (PT)

custom_lua_banner.text.source: Your init.lua also has custom Lua. It doesn’t conflict with the visual editor, and the app never modifies init.lua.
custom_lua_banner.text.translation: Texto Your init.lua also has custom Lua. It doesn’t conflict with the visual editor, and the app never modifies init.lua. (PT)

discard.apply_preset.message.source: Applying a preset replaces the edits you haven't saved.
discard.apply_preset.message.translation: Texto Applying a preset replaces the edits you haven't saved. (PT)

discard.delete_profile.message.source: Deleting reloads the dashboard, dropping the edits you haven't saved.
discard.delete_profile.message.translation: Texto Deleting reloads the dashboard, dropping the edits you haven't saved. (PT)

discard.load_profile.message.source: Loading a profile replaces the edits you haven't saved.
discard.load_profile.message.translation: Texto Loading a profile replaces the edits you haven't saved. (PT)

discard.lua_editor.message.source: The raw editor saves init.lua as text, so the edits you haven't saved are dropped.
discard.lua_editor.message.translation: Texto The raw editor saves init.lua as text, so the edits you haven't saved are dropped. (PT)

discard.rename_profile.message.source: Renaming reloads the dashboard, dropping the edits you haven't saved.
discard.rename_profile.message.translation: Texto Renaming reloads the dashboard, dropping the edits you haven't saved. (PT)

discard.switch_profile.message.source: Switching profiles drops the edits you haven't saved.
discard.switch_profile.message.translation: Texto Switching profiles drops the edits you haven't saved. (PT)

discard.visual_editor.message.source: Leaving the raw editor reloads init.lua from disk, dropping the Lua you haven't saved.
discard.visual_editor.message.translation: Texto Leaving the raw editor reloads init.lua from disk, dropping the Lua you haven't saved. (PT)

drag.border.off_help.source: Turn on Border to edit its color, width, and alignment.
drag.border.off_help.translation: Texto Turn on Border to edit its color, width, and alignment. (PT)

drag.caption.source: Drag a window onto another to swap their positions in the layout.
drag.caption.translation: Comportamento do arrasto e redimensionamento via mouse.

drag.disabled.help.source: Turn on Enabled to edit this visual.
drag.disabled.help.translation: Texto Turn on Enabled to edit this visual. (PT)

drag.drop_zone.caption.source: Marks the position your window will snap into when dropped.
drag.drop_zone.caption.translation: Texto Marks the position your window will snap into when dropped. (PT)

drag.fill.off_help.source: Turn on Fill to edit its color.
drag.fill.off_help.translation: Texto Turn on Fill to edit its color. (PT)

drag.ghost.caption.source: Marks the position your window is dragged from.
drag.ghost.caption.translation: Texto Marks the position your window is dragged from. (PT)

floating.color.space_bar_only.source: The floating mark is drawn only in the Space Bar, which is off.
floating.color.space_bar_only.translation: Texto The floating mark is drawn only in the Space Bar, which is off. (PT)

footer.revert.restores_layout.source: Revert also restores the profile layout (%1$@).

footer.save.adopts_layout.source: Save also adopts the session layout (%1$@).

footer.save.globals_only.source: Layout and monitors stay paused; Save covers everything else.
footer.save.globals_only.translation: Texto Layout and monitors stay paused; Save covers everything else. (PT)

footer.save_as_new.message.source: The new profile carries the current tiling and the connected monitor set.
footer.save_as_new.message.translation: Texto The new profile carries the current tiling and the connected monitor set. (PT)

footer.save_copy_as.message.source: Duplicates “%1$@” with your pending edits — monitor sets and shortcut overrides included. The copy becomes the edit target; the running layout is not changed.

gaps.mixed.help.source: Edges differ — edit them individually below.
gaps.mixed.help.translation: Texto Edges differ — edit them individually below. (PT)

gaps.outer_meaning.source: between windows and the screen edge
gaps.outer_meaning.translation: Texto between windows and the screen edge (PT)

general.advanced.edit_lua.caption.source: Opens the integrated Lua editor for custom scripting beyond the visual controls.
general.advanced.edit_lua.caption.translation: Texto Opens the integrated Lua editor for custom scripting beyond the visual controls. (PT)

help.button.hint.source: Shows an explanation of this setting.
help.button.hint.translation: Texto Shows an explanation of this setting. (PT)

icon_picker.search.placeholder.source: Search icons (or an SF Symbol name)
icon_picker.search.placeholder.translation: Texto Search icons (or an SF Symbol name) (PT)

key_recorder.help_press.source: A shortcut is one key plus any of ⌃ Control, ⌥ Option, ⇧ Shift, and ⌘ Command — it locks in the moment you press the key. For more shortcut layers, add Modes.
key_recorder.help_press.translation: Texto A shortcut is one key plus any of ⌃ Control, ⌥ Option, ⇧ Shift, and ⌘ Command — it locks in the moment you press the key. For more shortcut layers, add Modes. (PT)

key_recorder.live_applied.source: Active now — Save to keep it
key_recorder.live_applied.translation: Texto Active now — Save to keep it (PT)

key_recorder.live_apply_failed.source: The shortcut change was recorded but couldn't be applied live. Save or Revert to retry.
key_recorder.live_apply_failed.translation: Texto The shortcut change was recorded but couldn't be applied live. Save or Revert to retry. (PT)

key_recorder.live_compile_failed.translation: Texto Recorded — the action couldn't compile (PT)

key_recorder.live_denied.source: Recorded — the system didn't grant it
key_recorder.live_denied.translation: Texto Recorded — the system didn't grant it (PT)

key_recorder.live_profile_shadowed.source: Recorded — the active profile overrides it
key_recorder.live_profile_shadowed.translation: Texto Recorded — the active profile overrides it (PT)

key_recorder.revert_failed.source: Revert couldn't restore the running shortcuts. Fix the configuration, then try again.
key_recorder.revert_failed.translation: Texto Revert couldn't restore the running shortcuts. Fix the configuration, then try again. (PT)

key_recorder.revert_used_snapshot.source: Saved shortcuts couldn't be read, so Revert restored the previous running shortcuts.
key_recorder.revert_used_snapshot.translation: Texto Saved shortcuts couldn't be read, so Revert restored the previous running shortcuts. (PT)

keybinding.conflict.other_binding.translation: O atalho para '%1$@' está em conflito com '%2$@'.

keybinding.conflict.system.source: Shortcut for "%1$@" is conflicting with the macOS shortcut "%2$@".
keybinding.conflict.system.translation: O atalho para '%1$@' está em conflito com o atalho de sistema do macOS '%2$@'.

keybinding.conflict.unrecognized.source: Shortcut for "%1$@" isn't a recognized shortcut.

keybinding.move_to_space_follow.translation: Mover para o espaço %1$@ e seguir

keybinding.toggle_display_sticky.help.source: Keeps this window visible on every space of the monitor it lives on. Moving it to a space on another monitor re-homes it there. Turn a sticky window fully global with Toggle sticky.
keybinding.toggle_display_sticky.help.translation: Texto Keeps this window visible on every space of the monitor it lives on. Moving it to a space on another monitor re-homes it there. Turn a sticky window fully global with Toggle sticky. (PT)

keybinding.toggle_sticky.help.source: Keeps this window visible on every space. A tiled sticky window can be rearranged only on its home space — elsewhere, its position follows automatically. A floating sticky window isn't affected — it moves freely everywhere.
keybinding.toggle_sticky.help.translation: Texto Keeps this window visible on every space. A tiled sticky window can be rearranged only on its home space — elsewhere, its position follows automatically. A floating sticky window isn't affected — it moves freely everywhere. (PT)

layout.schematic.bsp.ax.source: BSP preview: width ratio %1$d percent, height ratio %2$d percent; the plus tile is where the next window lands.

layout.schematic.bsp.caption_alternating.source: Splits alternate horizontal then vertical; the + tile is where the next window opens.
layout.schematic.bsp.caption_alternating.translation: Texto Splits alternate horizontal then vertical; the + tile is where the next window opens. (PT)

layout.schematic.bsp.caption_longest.source: Each split cuts the longer side; the + tile is where the next window opens.
layout.schematic.bsp.caption_longest.translation: Texto Each split cuts the longer side; the + tile is where the next window opens. (PT)

layout.schematic.grid.caption_rigid.source: A fixed %1$d × %2$d grid; each window shrinks to a cell, extras stack in the last.

layout.schematic.grid.caption_rigid_auto.source: A fixed grid sized to your screen (about 3 × 3); each window shrinks to a cell.
layout.schematic.grid.caption_rigid_auto.translation: Texto A fixed grid sized to your screen (about 3 × 3); each window shrinks to a cell. (PT)

layout.schematic.grid.order_columns.source: New windows fill across a row, then wrap down.
layout.schematic.grid.order_columns.translation: Texto New windows fill across a row, then wrap down. (PT)

layout.schematic.grid.order_rows.source: New windows fill down a column, then wrap across.
layout.schematic.grid.order_rows.translation: Texto New windows fill down a column, then wrap across. (PT)

layout.schematic.monocle.ax.source: Monocle preview: one window fills the screen; focus cycles through the others.
layout.schematic.monocle.ax.translation: Texto Monocle preview: one window fills the screen; focus cycles through the others. (PT)

layout.schematic.monocle.caption_h.source: All windows fill the screen; new ones come to the front, and focus cycles left/right.
layout.schematic.monocle.caption_h.translation: Texto All windows fill the screen; new ones come to the front, and focus cycles left/right. (PT)

layout.schematic.monocle.caption_v.source: All windows fill the screen; new ones come to the front, and focus cycles up/down.
layout.schematic.monocle.caption_v.translation: Texto All windows fill the screen; new ones come to the front, and focus cycles up/down. (PT)

layout.schematic.scrolling.ax.source: Scrolling preview: a row of windows framed by the screen, continuing off both edges; the anchor window holds focus.
layout.schematic.scrolling.ax.translation: Texto Scrolling preview: a row of windows framed by the screen, continuing off both edges; the anchor window holds focus. (PT)

layout.schematic.scrolling.caption.source: Focus rests at the anchor; the row scrolls off past it. The + is where the next window opens.
layout.schematic.scrolling.caption.translation: Texto Focus rests at the anchor; the row scrolls off past it. The + is where the next window opens. (PT)

layout.schematic.scrolling.follow_ax.source: Follow preview: two frames — the focus steps one slot over and the viewport pans just enough to reveal it, leaving the previous window visible.
layout.schematic.scrolling.follow_ax.translation: Texto Follow preview: two frames — the focus steps one slot over and the viewport pans just enough to reveal it, leaving the previous window visible. (PT)

layout.schematic.scrolling.follow_b.source: When focus steps to the next window
layout.schematic.scrolling.follow_b.translation: Texto When focus steps to the next window (PT)

layout.schematic.scrolling.follow_captio.source: The viewport holds still and pans the minimum to reveal the focus, keeping the side you came from in view.
layout.schematic.scrolling.follow_captio.translation: Texto The viewport holds still and pans the minimum to reveal the focus, keeping the side you came from in view. (PT)

layout.schematic.stack.ax.source: Stack preview: %1$d master windows, master ratio %2$d percent; the plus tile is where the next window lands.

layout.schematic.stack.caption_all.source: Master zone and stack zone; when the stack fills, the whole zone piles so only the top edges show.
layout.schematic.stack.caption_all.translation: Texto Master zone and stack zone; when the stack fills, the whole zone piles so only the top edges show. (PT)

layout.schematic.stack.caption_overflow.source: Master zone and stack zone; when the stack fills, the surplus piles up.
layout.schematic.stack.caption_overflow.translation: Texto Master zone and stack zone; when the stack fills, the surplus piles up. (PT)

layout.schematic.track.ax.source: Track preview: tracks along one axis, the far one piling overflow; the plus is the next window.
layout.schematic.track.ax.translation: Texto Track preview: tracks along one axis, the far one piling overflow; the plus is the next window. (PT)

layout.schematic.track.caption_focused.source: New windows join the focused track; the far track piles the overflow.
layout.schematic.track.caption_focused.translation: Texto New windows join the focused track; the far track piles the overflow. (PT)

layout.schematic.track.caption_own.source: New windows open their own track; the far track piles the overflow.
layout.schematic.track.caption_own.translation: Texto New windows open their own track; the far track piles the overflow. (PT)

layout.track.header_caption.source: A more advanced layout: several windows can share one track, with a track limit and per-track resize.
layout.track.header_caption.translation: Texto A more advanced layout: several windows can share one track, with a track limit and per-track resize. (PT)

layout_defaults.min_window_size_caption.source: Windows never tile smaller than this. It also sets the auto-size grid's cell size.
layout_defaults.min_window_size_caption.translation: Texto Windows never tile smaller than this. It also sets the auto-size grid's cell size. (PT)

layout_params.master_orientation.help.source: How the master zone lines up its windows when the master count is more than one: stacked top to bottom, or side by side.
layout_params.master_orientation.help.translation: Texto How the master zone lines up its windows when the master count is more than one: stacked top to bottom, or side by side. (PT)

layout_params.overflow.stack.help.source:
**Cascade overflow** — Keeps as many windows fully tiled as fit, then cascades only the extra ones at the bottom.
**Cascade all** — Cascades the whole stack, showing a sliver of every window.
layout_params.overflow.stack.help.translation:
Texto **Cascade overflow** — Keeps as many windows fully tiled as fit, then cascades only the extra ones at the bottom.
**Cascade all** — Cascades the whole stack, showing a sliver of every window. (PT)

layout_params.overflow.track.help.source:
How the far-edge **overflow track** — which collects the tracks that don't fit side by side — packs its windows.
**Cascade all** (the default) — piles every window from the top.
**Cascade overflow** — tiles what fits, piles the rest.
An ordinary track that holds more windows than fit always overflows this second way; only the far-edge track is configurable.
layout_params.overflow.track.help.translation:
Texto How the far-edge **overflow track** — which collects the tracks that don't fit side by side — packs its windows.
**Cascade all** (the default) — piles every window from the top.
**Cascade overflow** — tiles what fits, piles the rest.
An ordinary track that holds more windows than fit always overflows this second way; only the far-edge track is configurable. (PT)

layout_params.split_ratio_h.help.source: How much of a side-by-side split's width goes to the earlier window; the later window gets the rest. Applies to every left/right split.
layout_params.split_ratio_h.help.translation: Texto How much of a side-by-side split's width goes to the earlier window; the later window gets the rest. Applies to every left/right split. (PT)

layout_params.split_ratio_v.help.source: How much of a stacked split's height goes to the earlier window; the later window gets the rest. Applies to every top/bottom split.
layout_params.split_ratio_v.help.translation: Texto How much of a stacked split's height goes to the earlier window; the later window gets the rest. Applies to every top/bottom split. (PT)

layout_params.split_strategy.help.source:
**Longest side** — Cuts whichever side of the region is longer, keeping new windows close to square.
**Alternating** — Alternates left/right and top/bottom cuts as the layout gets deeper, regardless of shape.
layout_params.split_strategy.help.translation:
Texto **Longest side** — Cuts whichever side of the region is longer, keeping new windows close to square.
**Alternating** — Alternates left/right and top/bottom cuts as the layout gets deeper, regardless of shape. (PT)

layout_params.stack_position.help.source: Which side of the screen the stack zone takes; the master zone gets the other side. The stack lines up to fit its strip: a left or right stack runs top to bottom, a top or bottom stack side by side.
layout_params.stack_position.help.translation: Texto Which side of the screen the stack zone takes; the master zone gets the other side. The stack lines up to fit its strip: a left or right stack runs top to bottom, a top or bottom stack side by side. (PT)

layout_params.wrap_focus.help.source: When on, moving focus past the last window wraps around to the first, and past the first back to the last, instead of stopping at the end.
layout_params.wrap_focus.help.translation: Texto When on, moving focus past the last window wraps around to the first, and past the first back to the last, instead of stopping at the end. (PT)

lua_editor.adopt.message.source: Your current init.lua is kept as a commented-out backup.
lua_editor.adopt.message.translation: Texto Your current init.lua is kept as a commented-out backup. (PT)

lua_editor.adopt.message_dirty.source: Your current init.lua is kept as a commented-out backup — but Adopt reads that file from disk, so the edits you haven't saved are dropped.
lua_editor.adopt.message_dirty.translation: Texto Your current init.lua is kept as a commented-out backup — but Adopt reads that file from disk, so the edits you haven't saved are dropped. (PT)

lua_editor.adopt.title.source: Adopt this config into the visual editor?
lua_editor.adopt.title.translation: Texto Adopt this config into the visual editor? (PT)

lua_editor.adopt_help.body.source: Your init.lua isn't deleted: it's kept as a commented-out backup in the new file. Gaps, layouts, rules, and keybindings are imported; a shortcut that can't be read back stays in the backup — re-add it in the Shortcuts section.
lua_editor.adopt_help.body.translation: Texto Your init.lua isn't deleted: it's kept as a commented-out backup in the new file. Gaps, layouts, rules, and keybindings are imported; a shortcut that can't be read back stays in the backup — re-add it in the Shortcuts section. (PT)

lua_editor.foreign_code.source: This init.lua contains hand-written Lua, so the visual editor is disabled to avoid overwriting it.
lua_editor.foreign_code.translation: Texto This init.lua contains hand-written Lua, so the visual editor is disabled to avoid overwriting it. (PT)

menu.accessibility_paused.tooltip.source: Click to grant Accessibility permission and resume tiling.
menu.accessibility_paused.tooltip.translation: Texto Click to grant Accessibility permission and resume tiling. (PT)

menu.layout.save.translation: Texto Save Current Layout to Profile (PT)

menu.profile_broken.translation: Texto Can't load — see Config Issues (PT)

menu.status.config_error.tooltip.source: Parts of the configuration could not be loaded — open Config Issues for details.
menu.status.config_error.tooltip.translation: Texto Parts of the configuration could not be loaded — open Config Issues for details. (PT)

menu.status.warning.tooltip.source: KiwiDesk needs Accessibility permission. Window management is paused.
menu.status.warning.tooltip.translation: Texto KiwiDesk needs Accessibility permission. Window management is paused. (PT)

monitor_chip.hint.auto.translation: Texto Placed automatically — drag to pin (PT)

monitor_chip.hint.main.source: Follows the main display — drag to pin, ⓧ for automatic
monitor_chip.hint.main.translation: Texto Follows the main display — drag to pin, ⓧ for automatic (PT)

monitor_chip.hint.pinned.source: Pinned to this monitor — drag to move, ⓧ for automatic
monitor_chip.hint.pinned.translation: Texto Pinned to this monitor — drag to move, ⓧ for automatic (PT)

monitors.advanced.caption.source: Profiles reattach automatically when a known monitor setup is reconnected.
monitors.advanced.caption.translation: Texto Profiles reattach automatically when a known monitor setup is reconnected. (PT)

monitors.cards.caption.source: Drag a space between cards to pin it to a monitor or have it follow the main display. Dimmed spaces are placed automatically. Right-click a space for the same moves.
monitors.cards.caption.translation: Texto Drag a space between cards to pin it to a monitor or have it follow the main display. Dimmed spaces are placed automatically. Right-click a space for the same moves. (PT)

monitors.not_connected.caption.source: This profile's monitors aren't attached right now, so its space placement can't be edited here. Connect its monitor setup to arrange spaces — the other sections still edit this profile.
monitors.not_connected.caption.translation: Texto This profile's monitors aren't attached right now, so its space placement can't be edited here. Connect its monitor setup to arrange spaces — the other sections still edit this profile. (PT)

monocle.app_bar_xref_state.source: The monocle app bar (currently %1$@) is configured in

native_spaces.empty.source: No native macOS Desktops detected. Add desktops in Mission Control to bind profiles.
native_spaces.empty.translation: Texto No native macOS Desktops detected. Add desktops in Mission Control to bind profiles. (PT)

native_spaces.intro.source: Each Desktop is a native macOS Space from Mission Control. Pick a profile to load it automatically when that Desktop activates.
native_spaces.intro.translation: Texto Each Desktop is a native macOS Space from Mission Control. Pick a profile to load it automatically when that Desktop activates. (PT)

native_spaces.separate_warning.source: Separate display Spaces are on. KiwiDesk uses one active profile across all displays, so Desktop bindings may be ambiguous.
native_spaces.separate_warning.translation: Texto Separate display Spaces are on. KiwiDesk uses one active profile across all displays, so Desktop bindings may be ambiguous. (PT)

notification.permission_lost.body.source: Accessibility permission was revoked. Re-enable it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility.
notification.permission_lost.body.translation: Texto Accessibility permission was revoked. Re-enable it in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility. (PT)

onboarding.discovery.popover.source: KiwiDesk lives here. Click anytime for layouts and settings.
onboarding.discovery.popover.translation: Texto KiwiDesk lives here. Click anytime for layouts and settings. (PT)

onboarding.grant.body.source:
1. Click “Open System Settings” below.
2. Find KiwiDesk in the list and turn it on.
3. Come back here — we detect it automatically.
onboarding.grant.body.translation:
Texto 1. Click “Open System Settings” below.
2. Find KiwiDesk in the list and turn it on.
3. Come back here — we detect it automatically. (PT)

onboarding.ready.body.source: KiwiDesk is already arranging your windows with sensible defaults. Open Settings and apply a preset for your setup — then fine-tune anything from there. You can always get back here from the menu bar.
onboarding.ready.body.translation: Texto KiwiDesk is already arranging your windows with sensible defaults. Open Settings and apply a preset for your setup — then fine-tune anything from there. You can always get back here from the menu bar. (PT)

onboarding.spaces.body.source:
KiwiDesk uses one active profile across all displays. For predictable Desktop-to-profile bindings, turn off “Displays have separate Spaces.”

Basic tiling still works if you keep it on. Changing this setting requires logging out and back in.
onboarding.spaces.body.translation:
Texto KiwiDesk uses one active profile across all displays. For predictable Desktop-to-profile bindings, turn off “Displays have separate Spaces.”

Basic tiling still works if you keep it on. Changing this setting requires logging out and back in. (PT)

onboarding.spaces.title.translation: Texto Use shared Spaces across displays (PT)

onboarding.welcome.body.source:
KiwiDesk arranges your windows automatically. To move and resize windows of other apps, macOS requires you to grant Accessibility permission.

KiwiDesk never reads your keystrokes and does not require disabling System Integrity Protection.
onboarding.welcome.body.translation:
O KiwiDesk organiza automaticamente suas janelas. Para mover e redimensionar janelas de outros apps, o macOS exige que você conceda a permissão de 'Acessibilidade'.

O KiwiDesk nunca lê suas teclas pressionadas e não exige a desativação da Proteção de Integridade do Sistema (SIP).

palettes.caption.source: Apply a bundled or saved set of colors to the App Bar, Space Bar, borders, and drag visuals — a one-time paint, not a live link.
palettes.caption.translation: Aplique um esquema de cores coordenado a toda a interface.

palettes.empty_hint.translation: Texto Palettes you save appear here. (PT)

palettes.reserved.source: That name is a built-in palette — choose another.
palettes.reserved.translation: Texto That name is a built-in palette — choose another. (PT)

placement.new_window.translation: Nova janela disposta lado a lado

placement.new_window.help.source: Where a new window lands relative to the others: First or Last in the layout's order, or right before or after whichever window is focused at the moment it opens.
placement.new_window.help.translation: Texto Where a new window lands relative to the others: First or Last in the layout's order, or right before or after whichever window is focused at the moment it opens. (PT)

presets.caption.source: Built-in layouts per screen count. Apply loads one and saves it as a real, editable profile — only available when the connected screen count matches.
presets.caption.translation: Salve e restaure suas disposições de janelas preferidas.

presets.coder_and_monitor.summary.source: Editor and terminals on the main display; dashboards and logs on the second.
presets.coder_and_monitor.summary.translation: Texto Editor and terminals on the main display; dashboards and logs on the second. (PT)

presets.command_center.summary.source: Workspace and docs center, communication left, logs and monitoring right.
presets.command_center.summary.translation: Texto Workspace and docs center, communication left, logs and monitoring right. (PT)

presets.developer.summary.source: IDE stack, scrolling docs, and a fullscreen preview space.
presets.developer.summary.translation: Texto IDE stack, scrolling docs, and a fullscreen preview space. (PT)

presets.dual_developer.summary.source: Code and docs on the main display; mail, chat, and media on the second.
presets.dual_developer.summary.translation: Texto Code and docs on the main display; mail, chat, and media on the second. (PT)

presets.editing_stored.source: Applying a preset switches your live layout, which editing a saved profile never does. Switch to Live to apply one.
presets.editing_stored.translation: Texto Applying a preset switches your live layout, which editing a saved profile never does. Switch to Live to apply one. (PT)

presets.focus_stack.summary.source: Two stacked task spaces and a deep-work monocle space.
presets.focus_stack.summary.translation: Texto Two stacked task spaces and a deep-work monocle space. (PT)

presets.minimalist.summary.source: Spacious gaps, a scrolling reading space, and single-focus work.
presets.minimalist.summary.translation: Texto Spacious gaps, a scrolling reading space, and single-focus work. (PT)

presets.start_here.source: Start here — apply a preset for your setup, then adjust anything from any tab.
presets.start_here.translation: Texto Start here — apply a preset for your setup, then adjust anything from any tab. (PT)

presets.visual_creative.summary.source: Frontend IDE and previews center, design canvas left, inspectors right.
presets.visual_creative.summary.translation: Texto Frontend IDE and previews center, design canvas left, inspectors right. (PT)

profile_header.menu.help.source: Pick a saved profile to edit — editing it won't switch your layout.
profile_header.menu.help.translation: Texto Pick a saved profile to edit — editing it won't switch your layout. (PT)

profile_header.status.built_in.source: Built-in layout — save as a profile to make it yours.
profile_header.status.built_in.translation: Texto Built-in layout — save as a profile to make it yours. (PT)

profile_header.status.editing_loaded.source: Editing %1$@'s saved overrides — saving re-applies %1$@ with your changes.

profile_header.status.editing_stored.source: Editing a saved profile — changes won't switch your layout.
profile_header.status.editing_stored.translation: Texto Editing a saved profile — changes won't switch your layout. (PT)

profile_header.status.no_match.source: No profile matches this monitor setup.
profile_header.status.no_match.translation: Texto No profile matches this monitor setup. (PT)

profile_header.status.unsaved_monitor.source: Unsaved monitor changes — update the profile to keep them.
profile_header.status.unsaved_monitor.translation: Texto Unsaved monitor changes — update the profile to keep them. (PT)

profiles.broken.cant_load.source: Can't load — saved by another version or edited by hand.
profiles.broken.cant_load.translation: Texto Can't load — saved by another version or edited by hand. (PT)

profiles.duplicate_default.help.source: Several profiles of this count are marked default; the alphabetically first wins.
profiles.duplicate_default.help.translation: Texto Several profiles of this count are marked default; the alphabetically first wins. (PT)

profiles.native_spaces.live_only.source: Desktop bindings are global — switch to Live to change them.
profiles.native_spaces.live_only.translation: Texto Desktop bindings are global — switch to Live to change them. (PT)

profiles.other_monitors.help.source: Saved for other monitors — loads with unsaved-changes state.
profiles.other_monitors.help.translation: Texto Saved for other monitors — loads with unsaved-changes state. (PT)

profiles.overlap_warning.source: This monitor set is also covered by %1$@ — exact-match ties load the alphabetically first.

profiles.save_blocked_paused.source: Window management is paused because Accessibility access is off, so no displays are detected. Grant access first — a profile saved now would capture no monitors and never resolve.
profiles.save_blocked_paused.translation: Texto Window management is paused because Accessibility access is off, so no displays are detected. Grant access first — a profile saved now would capture no monitors and never resolve. (PT)

profiles.saved.empty.source: No profiles saved yet — the built-in Standard resolves until you save one.
profiles.saved.empty.translation: Texto No profiles saved yet — the built-in Standard resolves until you save one. (PT)

profiles.update_hint.source: "%1$@" is for %2$d screen(s); %3$d connected. Save as new instead.
profiles.update_hint.translation: Texto "%1$@" is for %2$d screen(s); %3$d connected. Save as new instead. (PT)

scroll_grid.animate_focus_shifts.help.source: Moves windows smoothly when focus changes in a Scrolling space. Turn this off to move the layout immediately. Scroll speed sets how long the movement takes and has no effect while animation is off.
scroll_grid.animate_focus_shifts.help.translation: Texto Moves windows smoothly when focus changes in a Scrolling space. Turn this off to move the layout immediately. Scroll speed sets how long the movement takes and has no effect while animation is off. (PT)

scroll_grid.app_bar_xref_state.source: The scrolling app bar (currently %1$@) is configured in

scroll_grid.auto_size.gates.source: Auto-size grid is on for this space, so the screen decides the columns and rows.
scroll_grid.auto_size.gates.translation: Texto Auto-size grid is on for this space, so the screen decides the columns and rows. (PT)

scroll_grid.auto_size_caption.source: Fits as many columns and rows as the screen allows, using the minimum window size above.
scroll_grid.auto_size_caption.translation: Ajusta todas as colunas e linhas permitidas pela tela usando o tamanho mínimo de janela acima.

scroll_grid.fill_empty_space.rigid_only.source: A rigid grid keeps every cell, so there is no empty space to fill.
scroll_grid.fill_empty_space.rigid_only.translation: Texto A rigid grid keeps every cell, so there is no empty space to fill. (PT)

settings.permission_paused.source: Window management is paused — KiwiDesk needs Accessibility permission.
settings.permission_paused.translation: Texto Window management is paused — KiwiDesk needs Accessibility permission. (PT)

shortcuts.advanced.caption.source: Bind any Lua to a hotkey. This is the power-user escape hatch — the groups above cover the built-in actions.
shortcuts.advanced.caption.translation: Texto Bind any Lua to a hotkey. This is the power-user escape hatch — the groups above cover the built-in actions. (PT)

shortcuts.app_behavior.help.source:
**Open or Focus** brings the app's existing window to the current space, or launches it if the app isn't running.

**Open New** always launches a fresh instance, even when the app is already open.
shortcuts.app_behavior.help.translation:
Texto **Open or Focus** brings the app's existing window to the current space, or launches it if the app isn't running.

**Open New** always launches a fresh instance, even when the app is already open. (PT)

shortcuts.base_mode_protected.source: Base modes can't be removed here
shortcuts.base_mode_protected.translation: Texto Base modes can't be removed here (PT)

shortcuts.import.help.source: Reads the shortcuts active in init.lua and adds them here, matching each combo. Known actions sort into the groups below; anything else lands in Advanced. Review, then Save.
shortcuts.import.help.translation: Texto Reads the shortcuts active in init.lua and adds them here, matching each combo. Known actions sort into the groups below; anything else lands in Advanced. Review, then Save. (PT)

shortcuts.imported_note.source: Shortcuts imported — review below, then Save.
shortcuts.imported_note.translation: Texto Shortcuts imported — review below, then Save. (PT)

shortcuts.inactive.caption.source: These shortcuts target spaces that are not in the current space list. They still work — pressing one recreates its space — and they keep their key combo. Rebind or remove them here; they become active again when their space returns.
shortcuts.inactive.caption.translation: Texto These shortcuts target spaces that are not in the current space list. They still work — pressing one recreates its space — and they keep their key combo. Rebind or remove them here; they become active again when their space returns. (PT)

shortcuts.modes.caption.source: Modes are alternate shortcut sets — only the active mode's shortcuts fire. Bind a key below to switch between them. “default” is the standard mode and is always the active one after the app starts.
shortcuts.modes.caption.translation: Texto Modes are alternate shortcut sets — only the active mode's shortcuts fire. Bind a key below to switch between them. “default” is the standard mode and is always the active one after the app starts. (PT)

shortcuts.move_to_track.caption.source: Only relevant if you're using the track layout.
shortcuts.move_to_track.caption.translation: Texto Only relevant if you're using the track layout. (PT)

shortcuts.override.caption.source: Dimmed rows are inherited from the base shortcuts and stay in sync with them. Edit a row to override it for this profile only; matching the base again makes it inherited again. Removing an inherited row only resets it — to disable a combo in this profile, rebind it to a no-op action instead.
shortcuts.override.caption.translation: Texto Dimmed rows are inherited from the base shortcuts and stay in sync with them. Edit a row to override it for this profile only; matching the base again makes it inherited again. Removing an inherited row only resets it — to disable a combo in this profile, rebind it to a no-op action instead. (PT)

shortcuts.override.overrides.translation: Texto This profile overrides base keybindings. (PT)

shortcuts.override.staged.source: Editing “%1$@” — shortcuts take effect the next time this profile is active.

shortcuts.override.staged_loaded.source: Editing “%1$@” — shortcuts re-apply as soon as you save.

shortcuts.panel.dismiss_hint.source: Esc or click away to close
shortcuts.panel.dismiss_hint.translation: Texto Esc or click away to close (PT)

shortcuts.panel.unavailable.source: Shortcuts are managed by your init.lua.
shortcuts.panel.unavailable.translation: Texto Shortcuts are managed by your init.lua. (PT)

shortcuts.size_float.feedback.source: Alert sound when resize can't apply
shortcuts.size_float.feedback.translation: Texto Alert sound when resize can't apply (PT)

shortcuts.size_float.layouts_caption.source: Grow/Shrink only applies in the bsp, stack, scrolling, and track layouts; it is a no-op in monocle, grid, and floating. Width and height resize independently; scrolling resizes its slot along the scroll axis for both, and in track one axis resizes the window's track, the other its share within it.
shortcuts.size_float.layouts_caption.translation: Texto Grow/Shrink only applies in the bsp, stack, scrolling, and track layouts; it is a no-op in monocle, grid, and floating. Width and height resize independently; scrolling resizes its slot along the scroll axis for both, and in track one axis resizes the window's track, the other its share within it. (PT)

space_bar.alignment.label.help.source: Where the Space items — and the front-app segment, when shown — sit along the bar. Start and End follow the edge — a left bar's Start is its top.
space_bar.alignment.label.help.translation: Posição dos itens do espaço ao longo da barra.

space_bar.background_fit.boxed_only.source: Boxed draws a box per item, not a shared plate, so there is nothing to size.
space_bar.background_fit.boxed_only.translation: Em caixas desenha uma caixa para cada item.

space_bar.color.active_space.help.source: Tints the active space's identifier and its app glyphs.
space_bar.color.active_space.help.translation: Colore o identificador do espaço ativo e os símbolos de apps.

space_bar.color.focused_item.help.source: Tints the focused window — its glyph in the active Space and the front-app segment. Glyph tint needs Glyphs icon mode.
space_bar.color.focused_item.help.translation: Colore o símbolo da janela com foco.

space_bar.color.group_badge.help.source: Count and overflow badges on the active space; inactive spaces mute them from the item color. Grouping is always on.
space_bar.color.group_badge.help.translation: Colore os selos de contagem e transbordamento.

space_bar.copy_appearance.caption.source: Copies the App Bar's current sizes, style, and colors — a one-time starting point, not a live link.
space_bar.copy_appearance.caption.translation: Copia dimensões, estilo e cores atuais da App Bar.

space_bar.copy_appearance.help.source: Takes the App Bar's current sizes, style, and colors once; edits afterwards stay independent.
space_bar.copy_appearance.help.translation: Obtenha as configurações da App Bar de uma só vez.

space_bar.disabled.help.source: Turn on Show Space Bar to edit these settings.
space_bar.disabled.help.translation: Ative a Space Bar para editar as configurações.

space_bar.edge.label.help.source: Which screen edge the Space Bar occupies. Sharing an edge with the App Bar is fine — the two stack.
space_bar.edge.label.help.translation: A borda da tela na qual a Space Bar fica posicionada.

space_bar.enabled.help.source: One bar per display listing that display's Spaces — click a Space to switch to it. The bar reserves its edge in every layout.
space_bar.enabled.help.translation: Exibe a barra da lista de espaços por monitor.

space_bar.global_style.caption.source: One bar per display, every layout. All settings are global.
space_bar.global_style.caption.translation: Uma barra por tela para todos os layouts. As configurações são globais.

space_bar.glyph_cap.help.source: How many app glyphs a Space shows before the rest collapse into a +n badge. Adjacent windows of the same app count as one glyph.
space_bar.glyph_cap.help.translation: Quantidade de ícones de apps a exibir antes de agrupá-los em um selo +n.

space_bar.glyph_cap.summary.source: Up to %1$d app groups per Space; more collapse into a +n badge.
space_bar.glyph_cap.summary.translation: Exibe até %1$d grupos de apps por espaço.

space_bar.hide_empty.help.source: Spaces with no windows are hidden from the bar, except the Space you're currently on. Use a shortcut to jump to a hidden Space.
space_bar.hide_empty.help.translation: Oculta da barra os espaços que não contêm janelas.

space_bar.icon_source.help.source: How app glyphs are drawn. Glyphs shows a monochrome symbol colored by the bar's item colors; apps without a symbol keep their app icon.
space_bar.icon_source.help.translation: Escolha como os símbolos de apps são desenhados.

space_bar.preview.ax.translation: Pré-visualização da Space Bar: posição %1$@, estilo %2$@.

space_bar.show_front_app.help.source: Adds a trailing segment with the focused window of the Space each display currently shows. Icon-only on vertical bars.
space_bar.show_front_app.help.translation: Adiciona um segmento indicando a janela com foco de cada tela.

space_bar.spring_delay.help.source: Drag a window onto a Space and hold this long for the view to spring to that Space, so you can drop the window into its layout. A quicker drop moves the window there without switching.
space_bar.spring_delay.help.translation: Tempo de espera ao arrastar uma janela para trocar de espaço.

space_override.caption.translation: Configurações não selecionadas herdam padrões de %1$@.

space_override.floating.none.translation: Floating não possui substituições por espaço.

space_override.reset_all.translation: Redefinir todas as substituições de layout

space_override.reset_all_confirm.message.source: This clears every layout's saved overrides for this space, not just the current one. This can't be undone.
space_override.reset_all_confirm.message.translation: Isso apagará substituições salvas para cada layout neste espaço. Não é possível desfazer.

space_override.reset_all_confirm.title.translation: Redefinir todas as substituições de layout?

space_override.slot_size.help.source: Sets each scrolling window's size along the scroll direction. Horizontal uses column width; vertical uses row height. Default is 1100 pt horizontally and 80% of the available height vertically.
space_override.slot_size.help.translation: Define as dimensões de cada janela com rolagem ao longo do eixo de rolagem.

spaces.caption.source: Each space has its own layout. Add spaces here; they appear in the shortcut and app-rule lists too. Drag rows to reorder.
spaces.caption.translation: Cada espaço possui seu próprio layout. Arraste as linhas para reordenar.

spaces.customize.help.translation: Substituições de layout para este espaço

spaces.delete_confirm.message.source: This space has customized settings — its layout overrides, monitor pin, and any Main or Fallback role are removed too. You can add the space back, but not its settings.
spaces.delete_confirm.message.translation: Este espaço possui configurações personalizadas. Se for excluído, elas serão perdidas.

spaces.empty.source: No spaces yet — add one below. Until you do, every window tiles in a single default space.
spaces.empty.translation: Nenhum espaço presente. Adicione um abaixo.

spaces.fallback_badge.help.source: Windows from a removed space land here when you switch profiles.
spaces.fallback_badge.help.translation: Janelas de espaços excluídos durante a troca de perfil serão posicionadas aqui.

spaces.fallback_caption.source: When you switch profiles, windows from a space the new profile doesn't have land in its fallback space (the first space when none is chosen).
spaces.fallback_caption.translation: Janelas de espaços não presentes no novo perfil irão para o espaço de alternativa.

spaces.mode.help.translation: Modo de layout para este espaço

spaces.overrides.floating.help.translation: Floating não possui substituições de layout.

sticky.caption.source: Sticky windows stay visible on every space (Toggle sticky, in Shortcuts).
sticky.caption.translation: Janelas floating marcadas como Sticky permanecerão visíveis em todos os espaços.

sticky.color.a11y.translation: Cor da marca de janela Sticky

sticky.display.pill.source: Can only be moved to a different display

sticky.everywhere.pill.source: Sticky windows can't be moved to another space
sticky.everywhere.pill.translation: Janelas Sticky não podem ser movidas para outros espaços

sticky.home.pill.source: Can only be moved in its home space %1$@
sticky.home.pill.translation: Movível apenas para seu espaço de origem %1$@

sticky.mark.forced.source: On — the Space Bar is off, so this is the only sticky mark.
sticky.mark.forced.translation: Ativo — A Space Bar está desativada, portanto esta é a única marca Sticky.

sticky.mark.help.source: A sticky window can look identical to a normal one, so KiwiDesk draws a small mark in its top-right corner. The Space Bar shows its own sticky badge either way.
sticky.mark.help.translation: Desenha uma pequena marca no canto superior direito das janelas Sticky.

sticky.pile.pill.source: Sticky windows can't be moved to the pile

track.auto_tracks.gates.source: Auto track limit is on for this space, so the screen decides how many open.
track.auto_tracks.gates.translation: O limite automático da faixa está ativo para este espaço, portanto a tela decide quantas abrir.

track.auto_tracks_caption.source: Fits as many tracks as the screen allows, using the minimum window size above — opening and collapsing them as windows come and go.
track.auto_tracks_caption.translation: Ajusta todas as faixas permitidas pela tela usando o tamanho mínimo de janela acima.

track.limit_caption.source: Bounded by the minimum window size above: more tracks than fit collapse into the overflow track.
track.limit_caption.translation: Limitado pelo tamanho mínimo de janela acima: faixas excedentes agrupam-se na faixa de transbordamento.

track.new_window_position.help.source: With “Opens its own track”, where the new track lands among the tracks; with “Fills the focused track”, where the window lands inside it: First, Last, or right before or after the focused one.
track.new_window_position.help.translation: Especifica onde inserir a nova faixa ou janela.
